footer.tagline: Online Kirar lessons for accompanying Ethiopian Orthodox chanting, led by Deacon Abel (Abelkirar).
footer.joinCommunityDescription: Get updates about Kirar lessons and new handmade instruments.

hero.title: Learn Kirar for Orthodox chanting.
hero.description: Learn online with Deacon Abel (Abelkirar). Build the skill and confidence to accompany mezmur and prepare to serve in church.

mission.title: Helping more Kirar players prepare to serve
mission.paragraph1: Deacon Abel began learning Kirar through YouTube videos in 2012 of the Ethiopian calendar. Today, he teaches students online wherever they live.
mission.paragraph2: The purpose is clear: help students play Kirar with care, accompany Orthodox chanting, and grow ready to serve in their church.
mission.quote: Kirar lessons rooted in Orthodox service.

home.coursesTitle: Training for each stage of your playing
home.coursesDescription: Begin with the foundations, strengthen your playing, or prepare for greater responsibility in church. Tell Deacon Abel about your experience when you apply.
home.instrumentsTitle: Choose an instrument made for your needs
home.instrumentsDescription: Order a Kirar, Begena, or Masenqo in the shape, finish, and size that suits you. Shipping is available to the US, UK, and Europe.

beginner.title: Beginner
beginner.description: Learn the foundations of playing Kirar and begin accompanying Orthodox chanting.

intermediate.title: Intermediate
intermediate.description: Improve control, listening, and confidence as you learn to accompany chanting.

advanced.description: Refine your playing and judgement for greater responsibility in church.

about.title: Meet Deacon Abel (Abelkirar)
about.paragraph1: I began learning Kirar through YouTube videos in 2012 of the Ethiopian calendar.
about.paragraph2: Today I teach Kirar online to students who want to accompany Orthodox chanting and prepare to serve in church. Each student begins from their current level.
about.paragraph3: Abelkirar is especially for Ethiopian and Eritrean Orthodox communities outside Ethiopia, where a Kirar teacher may not be nearby. You can apply online and contact me with questions before you begin.
about.whyTitle: Learn Kirar with service in mind
about.whyDescription: The lessons focus on careful playing, steady progress, and the role of Kirar in accompanying Orthodox chanting.
about.learnDescription: Build reliable Kirar playing through lessons matched to your current level.
about.accompanyDescription: Learn to support mezmur and Orthodox chanting with care.
about.serveDescription: Prepare to use what you learn in church with confidence and responsibility.
